prompt:
Subject: refrain in the sense of restrain.

Composition: An adult reaches toward a tempting cookie on a plate, then deliberately pulls the hand back and folds both hands in their lap. Show the restrained gesture and thoughtful expression in one moment, without a prohibition sign or repeated panels.

Style: Match only the rounded 2D style of references/invidious.png: thick dark-brown outlines, simple readable shapes, restrained cartoon shading, and friendly faces when people appear.

Framing: One coherent scene, centered, with the complete subject occupying about 80–90% of the square. Keep all essential body parts and object tips fully inside the frame without clipping.

Output: One 512 x 512 PNG with true RGBA transparency in the background and gaps. No lettering, labels, logo, watermark, or checkerboard.
Style reference invidious.png only: friendly rounded 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. An adult pauses and calmly keeps their hand away from a tempting second slice of cake, choosing to restrain themself.
en: The adult refrains from taking another slice of cake.
